chunks: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj asked Abā Ibrāhīm, peace be upon him:
about women who perform the saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah on camels and riding animals: is it sufficient for them to stand beneath al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah where they can see the House?

key_terms.الصَّفَا: al-Ṣafā, one of the two stations of saʿy
key_terms.الْمَرْوَةِ: al-Marwah, the other station of saʿy

ai.seo_question: Is it sufficient for women performing saʿy while riding to stand beneath Ṣafā and Marwah where they can see the Kaʿbah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding women performing the saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah while riding. It indicates that it is sufficient for them to stand beneath al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah at a place from which they can see the Kaʿbah.
